| Timed OFF    | When this function is set, operation modes on the panel display will not change. The timing icon will show and the operation stops when the set time comes.   |
|--------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Timed ON     | When this function is on, the panel display will only display a question mark. The unit will operate as the set mode when the time comes.                     |
| Timed ON/OFF | The unit will start operating or stop according to the order of your setting.                                                                                 |
